text: 这个月市场整体倾向是偏积极的，虽然中间有些日子波动不大，但大部分时间都显示出积极的信号。月末来看，市场波动率处于一个中性水平，意味着市场既不太恐慌也不太乐观。收益率曲线是正斜率偏平的，这通常表示经济温和增长的预期。信用利差偏低，说明大家借钱的成本不高，市场环境比较宽松。个股表现比较独立，大家走势不太一致。总的来说，这个月市场环境偏向积极，但个股表现比较分散。（这是数据回顾不是预测，会错，过去不代表未来）
text_en: This month, the overall market trend was leaning positive. Although there were some days with little movement, most of the time, positive signals were shown. By the end of the month, market volatility was at a neutral level, meaning the market was neither too panicked nor too optimistic. The yield curve had a positive slope and was somewhat flat, which usually indicates expectations of moderate economic growth. Credit spreads were low, suggesting that the cost of borrowing money is not high and the market environment is relatively loose. Individual stock performance was quite independent, with their trends not being very consistent. Overall, the market environment this month leaned positive, but individual stock performance was quite scattered. (This is a data review, not a prediction. It can be wrong. The past does not represent the future.)
caveat: LLM 据本月真实因子走势生成的大白话回顾；喂真数据防瞎编，但仍可能误读。非预测、非荐股、会错，过去≠未来。每月 append 到 llm_monthly_log 公开计分。
